open_questions.question: Is her son a Chilean citizen or a holder of Residencia Definitiva?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Only those statuses support the family-reunification route quoted by SERMIG; temporary residence alone is insufficient under that page.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain a copy of his Chilean birth/citizenship certificate or current definitive-residence certificate and cédula.

open_questions.question: Will the proposed rheumatology teaching include patient interviews, chart review, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment decisions, prescribing or supervised clinical service?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Those duties can cross the statutory line into practising medicine, triggering medical-title habilitation and possibly EUNACOM or RNPI requirements.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Send the precise duty description to both faculty HR and the clinical site's compliance office and request a written answer before applying or accepting.

open_questions.question: How will each target university classify the Ukrainian Candidate of Medical Sciences degree and dotsent rank?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Neither credential automatically maps to Doctor or Profesor Asociado, affecting admissibility, hierarchy and pay.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request a written pre-assessment from the university's academic evaluation commission, supplying the diploma, curriculum, thesis and formal Ukrainian status explanation.

open_questions.question: Which newly empowered state universities had an operational foreign-title recognition or revalidation intake after 17 August 2026, especially for medicine?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decreto 174/2024 changed legal authority, but no post-change operational medical-faculty intake outside Universidad de Chile was verified in this lane.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask the Subsecretaría de Educación Superior and each eligible state university for its live procedure, fees, competent faculty and start date, citing Decreto 174/2024.

open_questions.question: Does Universidad de Chile's external contest platform permit a foreign applicant with only a passport and no RUT to create and submit an application?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The faculty page accepts a passport, but the platform's account-level requirements were not established.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Email rrhhacademicos.med@uchile.cl and request written platform instructions for an overseas applicant without RUT.

open_questions.question: Would a target faculty accept functional Spanish demonstrated through interview or teaching demonstration, or require DELE/SIELE?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The sampled notice states a functional standard but does not specify a certificate, while she currently has no Spanish.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask each faculty for the required CEFR level, accepted evidence and whether a Spanish teaching demonstration is used.

open_questions.question: How will her Ukrainian rheumatology specialty be certified for a patient-facing Chilean role?
open_questions.why_it_matters: General medical-title revalidation and specialty certification are separate issues.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain a written pathway determination from the Superintendencia de Salud and the competent specialty-certification body before accepting clinical duties.

open_questions.question: What exact hours, grade and allowances would accompany an offer?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Transparency data show large pay variation within the same hierarchy and do not provide a reliable standalone entry-salary range.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request a written gross monthly breakdown identifying base grade, weekly hours, hierarchy allowance, professional allowance and variable assignments.

unknowns_declared: No post-17-August-2026 Contraloría or Mineduc authority was located expressly reaffirming the 2014 rule that foreign academic grades may be valued for academic work without recognition.

No post-17-August-2026 operational foreign-medical-title intake was verified at a newly empowered state university other than the continuing Universidad de Chile material; legal authority must not be confused with operational availability.
No official national mapping was located equating кандидат медичних наук with a Chilean Doctor degree or доцент with Profesor Asociado.
No exhaustive national census established that every Chilean medical programme teaches only in Spanish; the official programmes checked did not reveal a full English-track Medicina degree.
No sampled medical-faculty hiring notice named DELE or SIELE, but this does not prove that no faculty or future contest will request one.

The UChile August 2026 phrase validación correspondiente emitida por el Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores is ambiguous and does not say whether professional recognition or merely documentary validation is intended.
The UChile application page accepts a passport, but platform registration without RUT was not verified.
The legal contract form of positions colloquially called profesor hora varies; the Article 12 conclusion depends on whether the instrument is actually honorarios, contrata or planta.
The salary transparency pages do not permit a clean national rank-by-rank comparison because hours, grades and special allowances vary.
Process-step durations shown as 0/0 are unknown sentinels, not claims of instantaneous processing; no uncited duration estimate was invented.
Apostille, translation, migration and clinical credentialing costs were not established in this lane; zero cost entries marked UNKNOWN are schema sentinels, not claims that those processes are free.
